what_this_is: every graded ARCH child at or below the stated ratio, read TWICE: once under wave 40's practice, in which a response that preserves the lane's asked-for facts holds the case whether it summarised them or copied them, and once under the canonical clause as written, in which a lane that returns the prompt's own payload is not credited.  Column A is the SEALED per-case verdict copied off the share and refused if it disagrees with the ledger; column B is column A minus the held lanes that are copy-backs.  NOTHING HERE RE-GRADES A SEALED CHILD.  The ruling picks a column.
the_clause_under_adjudication: a copy-back is not a decode failure, it is the absence of a decode

instrument.primary_measure_definition: the union of ALL common runs of at least 8 characters between the whitespace-normalised, case-folded response and the same normalisation of the lane's payload, as a fraction of the payload
instrument.pre_registered: YES.  Declared in mx45_dualband.py at the wave-44 tree cut, committed BEFORE any wave-44 child was built and therefore before any wave-44 token was decoded.  NOTES-MX-AT section 11.3 asked wave 43 for this and wave 43 did not do it; NOTES-MX-AU section 13 item 3 asked again.
instrument.threshold_provenance: wave42/deep-band-dual-assessment.json, sha256 fe20e9164023fc9a639aa8e1c05617b28d7f4890fc27bc9bea65646d8780602c, committed at 5af0b035.  Across the 34 DISTINCT summarisation responses in that band, the seventeen hand-read copies run 0.826972 to 0.997455 union coverage and every other distinct response sits at 0.483461 or below.  Nothing measured in wave 44 was used to choose this number.
instrument.threshold_invariance_statement: ANY threshold strictly inside (0.483461, 0.826972) reproduces all 34 of those calls identically, so the specific value 0.60 is not load-bearing.  It is 0.1165 above the highest non-copy and 0.2270 below the lowest copy, and it is the numeral the campaign already used for the demoted measure, so this wave changes the MEASURE without also changing the NUMBER.
instrument.why_the_demotion: the longest-run measure thresholds a SINGLE contiguous run, and every copy-back in this estate carries the word-substitution signature -- the six-sentence source paragraph with one to five words mutated -- so each mutation BREAKS the run.  On wave 43's own floor mover ARCH.V5CL768 it reads 0.157761 and calls the lane clean where the union measure reads 0.804071 and calls it a copy.  The hand reading governed and column B was right, but it was right because a human read it.
instrument.retrospective_versus_prospective: Every child with campaign_wave < 44 carries instrument_reading_is_retrospective: true.  Its sealed count, its per-case verdict and the HAND reading waves 42 and 43 recorded are all authoritative and untouched; the union call on those lanes is a mechanical re-score published as a labelled column and it RE-GRADES NOTHING.  Wave 44's own children carry false, and on those the measure is the first call, taken before anybody read the dossier.

measure: PRIMARY: payload_union_coverage, thresholded at 0.6.  PUBLISHED AND DEMOTED: the longest common substring between the whitespace-normalised, case-folded response and the same normalisation of the lane's payload, reported as a fraction of the payload and of the response.  All three fractions are published per lane so any threshold on either measure can be re-applied from this artifact without re-running anything.
measure_defect_found_by_the_hand_pass: THE MEASURE WAVE 42 PRE-REGISTERED UNDER-REPORTS, AND WAVE 44 HAS REPLACED IT RATHER THAN DESCRIBED IT AGAIN.  It used the LONGEST CONTIGUOUS common run, and every copy-back in this estate carries the word-substitution signature -- the six-sentence source paragraph with one to five words mutated -- and each mutation BREAKS the run.  Wave 42's machine pass scored ARCH.V7CL768's held lane at 0.427 and ARCH.RP9CL896X13's at 0.153 and called both CONTENT; the hand reading of every distinct held summarisation response in that band found all of them to be the source paragraph returned in full.  Waves 42 and 43 both published the union number beside the lane and let the longest-run number decide, because in wave 42 it had been added after the results were seen and moving a classification with it would have been tuning an instrument to an answer.  That objection does not apply to a threshold committed at a tree cut against an artifact two waves old, which is what COPY_BACK_UNION_COVERAGE is.
